reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter heel callus, urea cream and waterproof foot-file guide
method: Reviewed the draft against 15 sources on 2026-11-10. KDCA 국가건강정보포털 '굳은살과 티눈'(updated 2026-05-18): callus from repeated friction/pressure, more common in women, complications 통증·감염·궤양, nail-clipper/pain-plaster misuse can spread the lesion and cause secondary infection, 2003 UK study 18% lifetime plantar callus, pressure removal resolves callus. Foot skin anatomy: Science Advances 2019 (Boyle et al., sciadv.aay0244) measured plantar stratum corneum 16x thicker than non-plantar in the same patient (n=414/1440); Hashmi et al. 2015 (J Foot Ankle Res, doi 10.1186/s13047-015-0092-7) cites MRI data putting heel stratum corneum at about 0.28 mm. Fissure/hydration: Dovepress CWCMR 2018 cross-sectional study of 693 diabetic patients — heel fissure 10.4%, hydration 14.6%±6.3 with fissure vs 19.1%±6.0 without, ROC cut-off 20% (sensitivity 0.478, specificity 0.819). KCA 보도자료 2020-06-26 (no=1002962053): CISS 2015-2019 92 cases, skin adverse effects 53 (57.6%), eye 29 (31.5%), foot 14 (15.2%), female 75 (81.5%), 15 product labels/ads reviewed; Yonhap 2020-06-25 adds the soft-tissue-infection hospitalisation case. MFDS nedrug itemSeq=199702155 (반드레크림/우레아, 일반의약품): urea 200 mg/g (=20%), indications include 손·발바닥 각피증, 1일 1~수회 apply and rub, caution with inflammation/fissure, do not apply to ulcer/erosion/wound or mucosa. Urea concentration bands from Piquero-Casals et al. 2021 (Dermatol Ther, doi 10.1007/s13555-021-00611-y): 2-10% moisturising, 10-30% moisturising plus keratolytic, >=30% keratolytic. Petrolatum: MDedge 2022 (James et al.) states petrolatum reduces TEWL by 98% versus 20-30% for other oils; Ghadially et al. 1992 (JAAD) shows petrolatum fills stratum corneum interstices and accelerates barrier recovery. Electrical safety: KC 60335-1 clause 7.1 requires an IP number where water-ingress protection is not IPX0, clause 15.1.1 lists IPX1-IPX7 tests; 국가법령정보센터 별표 32 gives IPX5 12.5 L/min jet, IPX6 100 L/min, IPX7 1 m submersion for 30 minutes. Coupang checks on 2026-11-10 (판매량순): 쇼시 방수 발 각질제거기 B1KRW 24,840 won, 341 reviews, USB rechargeable, KC XU102710-21001A, reviews describe two speeds, two rollers and water rinsing; 더마겐 우레아 보습크림 180 g 14,700 won (26,000 list, 43% off), 1,172 reviews, manufacturer states urea 100,000 ppm (10%); 달팽이룸 뒤꿈치 실리콘 보습 패드 2개입 x4 8,980 won, 3,534 reviews. Affiliate deep links were issued from those live product URLs and each returned HTTP 302 to the matching itemId on 2026-11-10 19:37 KST. The stated 48,520 won three-step total is the sum of those three checked prices. Kakao Gift curator links are reused live links (h6TjVmdP 모리츠 충전식 온수 발 찜질기, bFGXVyDC 오설록 프리미엄 티 컬렉션); both returned HTTP 200 with matching og:title on 2026-11-10 because the curator dashboard still stops at a DKAPTCHA map challenge. Verified that the draft contains no 진단/치료법/처방/복용법/부작용 wording in title, description, targetQuery or tags, and that every product claim matches what the seller page displays (the 20% urea figure is attributed to the pharmacy OTC label, while the linked Coupang cream is explicitly described as 10%).
